mission_1.description: Karl Fairburne and a squad of US Rangers infiltrate the Nazi-occupied seaside town of Colline-Sur-Mer, under cover of an Allied aerial assault. Karl's orders are to take out a Radar Tower before rendezvousing with his Resistance contact, Blue Viper.

mission_2.description: Trapped behind enemy lines, Karl prepares to strike back at Obergruppenführer Abelard Möller, the Nazi responsible for ongoing atrocities and attacks on the French Resistance. Möller's operations are shrouded in secrecy, but the Resistance believe the Nazi stronghold of Chateau de Berengar holds the key.

mission_10_dlc.kill_challenge: Assassinate Adolf Hitler (multiple methods: chandelier, bowling pin, poison, explosion).

mission_11_dlc.description: After the successful Normandy landing to the north, Operation Dragoon prepares to apply pressure on the Nazis from the south and force them out of France.

mission_12_dlc.title: Conqueror
mission_12_dlc.description: The Nazis have been driven back to Falaise Castle, where they are making a desperate last stand. Karl has orders to secure the town, breach the castle walls, eliminate General Konig, and force a German surrender.

mission_14_dlc.description: Resistance scouts have traced the Nazi's Kraken convoys to a Drydock base. Further intel also confirms that Vogel, previous assistant to Möller is now leading Project Kraken. Infiltrate the Nazi base, eliminate Vogel and disrupt whatever the Nazis are up to.

crossplay.no_cross_mode: Multiplayer has a "No Cross" mode for players who want to avoid cross-platform matchmaking.
crossplay.invites: Open the lobby or pre-load screen, select the user info panel (F2 on PC, Y / Triangle on console) and exchange invite codes.

ribbon_totals.note: Multiplayer: Tactics 12, Performance 12 and Support 8 are complete. "combat" is a placeholder name for the first category (header not captured); 11 of its ribbons recorded so far. multiplayer_unverified holds older entries not seen in game.
